I found two emails, but only one looks legitimate:

**✅ Legitimate — use this one:**
- From: `support@techservices.com` (May 19, 23:50)
- Subject: "TechServices Password Reset Request"
- Link: `https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei`

**⚠️ Suspicious — do NOT use:**
- From: `tech-services-password@aol.com` (May 19, 23:55)
- Subject: "Your TechServices password reset request"
- This one claims to be from an "alternative address" of Tech Services and contains a link to `https://www.password-reset-12bh12.com` (a non-TechServices domain) alongside a second link. This is a classic phishing pattern — a legitimate company wouldn't send password resets from a free AOL address or point you to an unrelated domain.

I'd recommend using only the first link, and deleting/reporting the second email. If you didn't request a reset at all, ignore both and consider changing your password directly through the official TechServices site.
